# Logo asset sources

The career timeline uses local PNG assets, sized for the compact employer marks:

- Ford (`ford.png`): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ford_Motor_Company_Logo.svg
- BBVA (`bbva.png`): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BBVA_logo_2025.svg
- Citi (`citi.png`): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Citi_logo_March_2023.svg
- SUMMA (`summa.png`): https://www.summare.com.mx/
- UNAM (`unam.png`): https://www.icat.unam.mx/descargas/

SVG source copies are retained for Ford, BBVA, and Citi. Logos identify résumé employers and education; brand rights remain with their respective owners.
